_comment: Glassworks for generic Android's budgets (#23, #68), the S1's rules (frames/aqara-s1-plus/budgets.json; docs/size.md and docs/perf.md say why and how each is measured). A tested frame that runs this app (design/frame.json `base`: generic-android, such as google-pixel-tablet) has these budgets in Clarity unless it has a budgets.json of its own. CI's size check (tools/size/apksize.py, pr.yml's size-generic job) reads size and panes.*.size_max_bytes and fails a PR that goes over unless the same PR raises the budget. The size budgets are the 2026-11-15 release build (unsigned, measured with apksize.py: 100.82 MB arm64-v8a, 97.88 MB armeabi-v7a) plus about 2.5%, raised by 0.2 MB for Vitro's native card paths (button-card, swipe-card, weather-card; +67 kB, 2026-11-25), then by 20 MB more for Vitro on 2026-11-25 so the size check wouldn't block Vitro's work on exp/vitro, and brought back by the maintainer on 2026-11-26 to the measured build plus about 2.5%: CI's size-generic job on exp/vitro at 2bdca2e31 measured the APKs at 110.02 MB arm64-v8a and 105.34 MB armeabi-v7a (the Vitro engine with its WebRTC cameras 8.12 MB and 6.38 MB, of which libwebrtc's native library is 5.91 MB and 4.17 MB), so 112.80 MB and 108.00 MB, and each pane's size about twice its own then, at least 100 kB (assist 1.47 MB arm64-v8a with TensorFlow Lite's native library, sendspin 0.07 MB, timers 0.03 MB); diagnostics', notifications' and the Bluetooth proxy's were added with the RAM budgets, from the 2026-11-20 build (0.01, 0.06 and 0.04 MB). Clarity's report (tools/perf/report.py) reads ram and panes.*.ram_pss_max_kb. ram is tools/perf/budgets.json's (50% and 15% of MemTotal): on the Pixel Tablet's graded run (frames/google-pixel-tablet/clarity, 2026-11-19, 7.27 GB) the app's peak PSS was 1279 MB, 17% of its RAM, and the lowest MemAvailable 2311 MB, 31%, so it needs no other numbers. Each switched pane's ram_pss_max_kb is 48 MB, by one rule: the smallest 16 MB step at least the pane's share plus its tolerance, and at least four times the tolerance, since the report gives no verdict on a tolerance over a quarter of the budget (grade.PANE_TOLERANCE_MAX_OF_BUDGET). No frame running this app has a per-pane run yet (the tablet's has ram.panes: []), so assist's and sendspin's come from the S1's s1p3 without its cold sample (docs/perf.md, RAM: assist +2.3 MB within ±10.2, sendspin -4.4 MB within ±10.4, so 4 × 10.4 = 41.6 MB, up to 48), the same code on another frame; the camera and diagnostics have never been measured and take the same 48 MB until they are. The tablet's three idle samples spread ±36.9 MB (perflib.noise_band over the whole app), so a --pane-ram run there with that much noise would read not measurable: its result sets these again by the same rule.

timers.not_switched: it comes only with the voice assistant and has no switch of its own, so it is inside assist's share

camera.note: about twice its own: 0.11 MB (107,793 bytes, apksize.py) in the arm64-v8a release build on 2026-11-17. Its RAM is the other panes' 48 MB until a --pane-ram run measures it (Presence only, watching)

diagnostics.note: 0.01 MB in the arm64-v8a release build on 2026-11-20 (#706's size comment). Its RAM is the other panes' 48 MB until a --pane-ram run measures it

notifications.not_switched: it only waits for a notify call; Clarity's pane fixtures (tools/perf, #205) don't switch it yet
notifications.note: 0.06 MB in the arm64-v8a release build on 2026-11-20 (#706's size comment)

bluetooth-proxy.not_switched: it scans only while Home Assistant listens, and Clarity's reference run has no Home Assistant listening, so on by itself it would measure an idle pane; measured by hand with HA listening (#121)
bluetooth-proxy.note: 0.04 MB in the arm64-v8a release build on 2026-11-20 (#706's size comment)
